# state has velocity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateHasVelocity`](gmeow-stateHasVelocity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateHasVelocity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The linear velocity of the entity at this location state, expressed as a scalar quantity (value + unit) in the state's reference frame. Non-functional: competing velocity readings from different sensors coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) -> [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)

Use [`gmeow:stateHasVelocity`](gmeow-stateHasVelocity.md) from [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) to [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the linear velocity at a location state, as a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) in the state's frame; non-functional, so competing sensor readings coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for angular velocity (use [`gmeow:stateHasAngularVelocity`](gmeow-stateHasAngularVelocity.md)) and avoid a bare number without unit and frame.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:stateHasVelocity`](gmeow-stateHasVelocity.md) at a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) (value + unit) expressed in the [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md).
